# TRUXO Heavy Equipment Rental

> TRUXO rents excavators, forklifts, wheel loaders, cranes and trucks to construction, industrial and infrastructure projects across Dubai and the United Arab Emirates. Equipment is inspected and serviced, mobilized directly to the customer's site, on flexible daily, weekly and monthly terms.
